Runtime multiword facts have no [i,dag] entry in any release, and the current sentence has zero candidate and matched MWE occurrences. i is rejected only by a learning-dictionary admission rule; no grammar lexical class member for i exists. In the current RPC V32 precedes the MWE builder; compiled PP rule is absent from v1.37 membership.
